summary: Revised the availability experiment for the replay-completion question to remove its single-batch-size limitation. The harness at draft/assurance_multi_test.go now runs a third case at Config.MaxAppendEntries 64, the library default, with 9000 committed commands so the replayed range is 9001 entries and needs 141 batches against the 128-batch bound; the two earlier cases at batch size 16 are unchanged (previous_id 16c25787045d480683724439289a6ecc-experiment, with the reason recorded). One admission records the flag-on restart at the default batch size and one comparison asserts that, where the restart did not return, stopping one further member must not cost the group its ability to commit, with commit_while_two_live_ok as the companion evidence that the group was healthy before that stop. Local construction feedback reproduced the intended outcome: the prefix recorded staged commit index 9001 with 141 entry-based batches, the restart did not return with two stack samples naming the replay frames, the group committed with two members live, and the commit failed after the second stop. The retained receipt is requested, and citing it in the account remains for the next turn if the run allows.
